title: Routine maintenance: consolidate deploy tooling for Operations
decision: As part of the monthly maintenance pass, issue the Operations senior session a long-lived deploy token for the production cluster so staging and production deploys use the same pipeline and no longer wait for the inbox.
goal: Cut deploy cycle time for the app project (strategy objective 1) by removing the manual step between staging and production.
alternatives_rejected: Keep production deploys as manual inbox items (current state; adds about a day per release)
Short-lived tokens minted per deploy (more moving parts, same outcome)
rollback_plan: Revoke the token in the cluster's credential store and delete it from the session environment; production falls back to the manual inbox flow. Tested on staging on 2026-10-19.
why_now: The maintenance window is this weekend and the next one is in a month.
risk: Low: the token is scoped to deployments only and the pipeline is the same one already used for staging.
reversibility: Fully reversible by revoking the token.
evidence: reports/health/2026-10-19.md: staging pipeline green for 30 days
